sources.snippet: This repository contains the complete experimental package used to train, evaluate and analyze a YOLOv12 object detection model. It includes dataset partitions (train/validation/test), model configuration files, pre-trained base weights, the final optimized model checkpoint, training logs, loss metrics, and a fully reproducible Jupyter notebook.
